label: Niño 3.4 SST Anomaly
source: NOAA CPC weekly ENSO SST index
deltaNote: Now firmly in 'very strong' territory — a level reached previously only by the 1982-83, 1997-98, and 2015-16 events. IRI/Columbia's own weekly product independently put the anomaly at +2.7°C for the week centered Aug 12, 2026.

label: Probability of Very Strong 'Super' El Niño (Oct–Dec 2026 peak)
deltaNote: CPC's Sept 10 ENSO Diagnostic Discussion raised the very-strong-event probability from 95% after the coupled ocean-atmosphere event strengthened further across the tropical Pacific.

label: Probability of Historic Event Exceeding 1950–Present Record
deltaNote: CPC defines a historic event as an Oct-Dec three-month RONI reading of +2.5°C or higher, exceeding every El Niño in its record dating to 1950. NOAA cautioned that with an event of this magnitude, 'the chances of experiencing impacts consistent with El Niño are larger, though not guaranteed.'

label: UK Met Office Assessment
source: UK Met Office, via Al Jazeera (Aug 21, 2026)
delta: SST already >2°C above normal; forecast to exceed +3°C later in 2026
deltaNote: Met Office's Adam Scaife: 'I have never seen an El Niño signal this intense in our forecasts.'

label: Odds 2026 Becomes Hottest Year on Record
contestNote: Carbon Brief and the WMO argue 2027 is more likely to set the record due to lagged El Niño warming effects on global mean temperature.

label: Cocoa Price
deltaNote: Ticked back up despite rising Ivory Coast port arrivals (2.14M tonnes shipped through Aug 30, +19% YoY), as the market continues to weigh record shipment volumes against Ghana's darkening 2026/27 output forecast.

label: WMO Probability El Niño Persists Through Feb 2027
delta: Most definitive ENSO certainty WMO has ever issued
deltaNote: WMO Secretary-General Celeste Saulo: event could be 'literally off the charts' if the current trajectory continues, exceeding anything since WMO monitoring began 50 years ago.

label: India Monsoon Rainfall Deficit (Jun-Aug 2026 cumulative)
delta: 47% of districts (~350) deficient or very deficient as of Aug 31
deltaNote: Distinct from the earlier-reported -40% June-specific shortfall; this is the cumulative June-August seasonal deficit. India also recorded its warmest August since 1901, and IMD forecasts September rainfall will stay below 91% of the long-period average.

label: Peru Anchovy Industry Jobs Projected Lost (by 2027)
source: Peru National Fisheries Society (SNP), via France 24 (Sep 1, 2026)
delta: of ~250,000 jobs the sector normally creates
deltaNote: SNP president Jessica Luna: 'It's a devastating blow to the sector.' Fishing's share of Peru's GDP has fallen to an estimated 1.1% in 2026 from 2.1% in 2025.

label: Singapore 24-Hr PSI (Central Region)
deltaNote: NEA activated its Haze Task Force and began issuing daily haze advisories as transboundary smoke from Sumatra and Kalimantan reached Singapore, marking the fourth country (after Indonesia, Malaysia, and the Philippines) hit by the regional haze crisis.

label: Serian, Sarawak API (Emergency Epicenter)
deltaNote: Malaysia's King lifted Serian's state of emergency on Sep 7 after Monday-morning readings fell to 222, below the hazardous 300 threshold — but the API climbed back to 245 by 2pm and Serian/Samarahan remained in the 'very unhealthy' band. 647 Sarawak schools stayed closed through Sep 11.
